scope.purpose: read-only acceptance checklist for a fresh JSON-only evaluator follow-on

prerequisites: Reconcile any interrupted parent-v3 reservation with the same parent ledger before creating a retry or evaluator request.
Use a fresh v34 raw-to-label report and a fresh independent V16 proof; historical proof hashes are forbidden.
The proof labels.v16_sha256 must equal the fresh V16 result SHA after the evaluator reservation is applied.
Keep the fresh executor report, raw report, V16 result, private runtime audit, and evaluator output under the relocated target/output roots.
The exact literal virtualenv invocation path must remain in argv[0]; resolving it to the system interpreter is a failure.

assert: original_path_fallback == FORBIDDEN
path is inside the bound fresh output root
report path is inside the bound fresh product roots
v16_forward.result exists
proof SHA is not historical
qualification QI/QN/QE remain UNKNOWN
V16 SHA equals fresh result after reserved digest

source_copy_group.evidence: fresh parent-v3 report and its filtered strace prefix
assert: all source-copy paths are relocated targets or declared runtime files
original H5/BI4/raw paths are absent
private worker PID is separate from source-copy PID
trace files are under the fresh output root
no original source path is opened

trace_and_pid_checks.trace_interpretation: A missing trace after a failed child is UNKNOWN/MAY_HAVE_OPENED, never proof of no read; successful private SDK evidence requires the C-level filtered trace plus module path audit.

assert: every private SDK/evaluator module.__file__ is under relocated target_root/runtime
no module.__file__ resolves to the original worktree or source bundle
all declared role hashes match copied files
runtime audit path itself is under the relocated target root

relocated_sdk_checks.procedure: Run only the declared JSON evaluator/SDK entry with the literal virtualenv and relocated request/result paths; capture argv, module.__file__, exit status, and output SHA.
assert: no H5/BI4/raw input is opened
no original-path fallback
output is a new file in the fresh evaluator namespace
existing_product_bytes_before is measured before reservation
new_evaluator_bytes equals after_tree minus before_tree
old cold-product bytes are not charged again
external output delta and Home receipt bytes are separate fields
trace bytes are reported and included once in the external tree delta
same parent ledger and no ledger reset
timer starts before request load/metadata validation
static/result digest runs after reservation
returned charge CPU includes finalization through terminal charge
cleanup is bounded and owned child groups are gone
reservation is removed exactly once
charge ID is unique/idempotent
failed preflight after reservation is charged conservatively or released only after a failed charge
no orphan reservation remains

credit_boundary: This checklist is a pending procedure. It is not evidence of a fresh report, SDK execution, portability, or scientific qualification until root records the actual relocated run and independently verifies the fields above.
